stories.title: 'This is family' | Southeast Indianapolis bar hosts Thanksgiving dinner for all
stories.summary: A Thanksgiving dinner with all the fixings was prepared for anyone who wanted to stop by the One More Lounge on Southeastern Avenue Thursday.

stories.title: Macy's parade postponement has Hoosiers changing plans in New York City
stories.summary: While one Indiana family was able to adjust their plans to stay for Saturday's rescheduled parade, another Hoosier wasn't as fortunate.

stories.title: Indiana guardsmen return home from deployment in time for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: About 120 Indiana National Guard soldiers came home Wednesday after a yearlong deployment on the U.S.-Mexico border in Texas.

stories.title: Thousands of lights spread holiday cheer outside downtown Indianapolis home, benefiting shelter pets
stories.summary: Thousands of bulbs illuminate the home of Kurt and Kate Flock at 1219 N. Alabama St. every year, drawing drive-through viewings and people stopping to take pictures.

stories.title: At least 1 killed in Kentucky Avenue crash Thanksgiving evening
stories.summary: The crash happened around 6 p.m. Nov. 26 in front of the Kroger store on Kentucky Avenue near Mann Road.

stories.title: New Palestine man sentenced following guilty plea in deadly Hendricks County crash
stories.summary: In addition to serving prison time for the Feb. 18 crash, Sukhdeep Singh also had his license suspended and was ordered to pay $36,549.73 in total restitution.

stories.title: Illinois woman arrested for June crash that killed 19-year-old, injured 2 juveniles in northwest Indiana
stories.summary: The arrest followed an investigation into the June 8 crash that killed 19-year-old Marjorie Rottier and severely injured a 14- and 7-year-old near DeMotte.

stories.title: Southern Indiana business owner accused of selling generic Viagra without prescriptions
stories.summary: Police said the investigation began in August after a sign advertising generic Viagra was seen at Discount West Fireworks in Salem.

stories.title: Indianapolis family keeps Thanksgiving tradition alive to honor man killed in 2025 hit-and-run
stories.summary: Avery Neal was killed in a hit-and-run on Oct. 4, 2025. The driver, Dominique King, was sentenced to eight years in prison about a year later on Oct. 28, 2026.

stories.title: 89-year-old woman dies after 3-car crash in Monroe County
stories.summary: The crash happened Wednesday evening, Nov. 25, at the intersection of State Road 46 and Hunter Valley Road, just west of Interstate 69.

stories.title: Court docs: Man charged after confessing to killing missing Shelby County man 20 years ago
stories.summary: Two decades after Walter Smith disappeared, court records show Thomas Vaughn Blackburn is charged with murder after a reported confession.

stories.title: Man critically injured in shooting on Indy's south side Thanksgiving morning
stories.summary: Just before 4:30 a.m. Nov. 26, IMPD responded to reports of shots fired near Bluff Road and West Banta Road, outside the Creek Bay apartment buildings.
